instruments.official_title: Стратегия развития искусственного интеллекта в Республике Таджикистан на период до 2040 года
instruments.english_title: Strategy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence in the Republic of Tajikistan for the Period up to 2040
instruments.issuing_authority: Government of the Republic of Tajikistan
instruments.current_status: Approved as Annex 1 to Government Resolution No. 483 of 30 September 2022 and amended by Government Resolution No. 83 of 31 January 2025 (the text read is the consolidated Russian version as amended in 2025, which names the Agency for Innovation and Digital Technologies under the President as the authorised state body for the digital economy). The strategy runs to 2040 in six stages implemented through an action plan to be approved by the Government; that action plan was not found online (see leads). The egov.tj PDF appears to contain the strategy text only up to the e-government section (§3 of the priority areas); a Tajik-language version is listed on the Communications Service site. Not yet verified from the official text: the Tajik-language version.
instruments.summary: Tajikistan's national AI strategy, adopted by the Government to support the fourth national strategic goal of accelerated industrialisation, defines AI and sets goals, priorities and six implementation stages to 2040: legal, institutional and infrastructure foundations and specialist training in the first two stages, wide AI use in public services, education, health, industry, finance and utilities in stages three and four. It notes that no single authorised state body for AI exists and tasks the Government with creating an AI Council, AI units within ministries, agencies and local executive bodies, aligning national standards with international AI standards and joining international conventions. Sector chapters cover smart regions, education (AI faculties in 7 universities and three AI laboratories by 2026, 5,000 AI specialists by 2040) and AI in e-government.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Only national AI-specific policy instrument found; sets the institutional agenda (AI Council, ministry AI units, standards alignment).
instruments.publisher_name: Government of the Republic of Tajikistan

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Tajikistan's official legislation databases, the Ministry of Justice portal, the President's and e-government sites, ministries, the National Bank and the Communications Service were searched. Apart from the national AI strategy, no qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. The official legislation databases were unavailable, so a possible AI law and the official text of the personal data law are listed as leads to check later.
coverage_audit.technical_note:
Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. mmk.tj (National Legislation Centre) reset/503; adlia.tj and parlament.tj reset/503; Tajik-language strategy PDF on cs.gov.tj reset/503; portali-huquqi.tj search unusable. Strategy read from the Russian PDF on egov.tj (6 pages; possibly an extract). Personal Data Protection Law (2018) seen only in unofficial copies. Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Searched for AI law, AI provisions and bills; official legislation databases (mmk.tj, adlia.tj, parlament.tj) unreachable; Ministry of Justice portal reachable but search unusable; nothing confirmed (AI law and personal data law held as leads).; Government: AI Development Strategy to 2040 (Resolution No. 483 of 2022, amended 2025) found and read on the e-government portal; president.tj document search returned nothing on AI.; Ministries: Searched for ministry AI documents (education, health, justice, defence, finance, labour, interior); none found.; Regulators: National Bank (nbt.tj) and Communications Service searched; no AI-specific guidance found. No separate data protection authority identified.. Not reached: mmk.tj (National Legislation Centre) database; adlia.tj; parlament.tj (Majlisi Namoyandagon); cs.gov.tj (Communications Service) PDF. Could not verify: Law on Personal Data Protection (2018) official text: mmk.tj/adlia.tj unreachable; Tajik-language strategy PDF on cs.gov.tj (connection reset / HTTP 503). binding-law, ethics, risk-assurance, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found. Local retry 2026-10-18 (home connection, Saudi Arabia, ~20-minute time box): still failed: mmk.tj (curl timeout after 745 s, headless Edge ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT), adlia.tj, www.adlia.tj, parlament.tj, www.parlament.tj, cs.gov.tj, www.mmk.tj, portali-huquqi.tj (all TCP connect timeout ~21 s); amcu.gki.tj TLS error. Reachable: president.tj (200), egov.tj (200; strategy PDF re-fetched 200, 144805 bytes), nbt.tj (200), mintrans.tj (200), innovation.tj (redirects to egov.tj agency page). president.tj is a React app; its document API controlpanel.president.tj/api/search_document (GET, params event_type, page, searchText, lang_id) works but searchText filtering returns 0 for every term, so the latest 150 items of decrees (back to 2025-01-04), resolutions (back to 2025-05-02), all 10 directives and 150 commands were scanned for 'сунъ|интеллект|зеҳни'. Hits: resolution 54884 (2026-03-10, establishes an Institute of Digital Technologies and AI at a university; held as lead), resolution 55844 (2026-06-15, rector appointment), presidential orders on the annual 'Ilm-furugi ma'rifat' contest listing an AI category (out of scope). No AI law signing decree, no National AI Corporation founding act, no strategy action plan. Not done for lack of time: nbt.tj and ministry site searches were not repeated (done on 2026-10-12).
Wording note 2026-10-19 (i-92ea9f93956e current_status): a Tajik-language version is listed on the Communications Service site but could not be opened on 2026-10-12.
